_meta.source: dispatches/ground_truth_validation.csv (numerical L/U/x0) + user 2026-04-17 full-dataset visual inspection (boolean features)
_meta.notes: Numerical bounds (L, U, x0) copied from CSV. Boolean feature presence (lower/upper/interior) follows the 2026-04-17 bullet list; several CSV interior=0 entries have been corrected to interior=true here per the user's firmed-up assessment (see per-parameter csv_interior_divergence flags). Schema: `x0` is the optimizer's initial-guess value (pipeline fact from the CSV); `interior_locations` is the empirical list of x-values where visual inspection observes a spike. They usually coincide, but the pipeline x0 may not be where the spike actually forms — see `e.w.a` (x0=0 with spikes at 0 and -25) and `ab.a` (x0=0 but the interior spike is at x=1 while x=0 is lower-boundary stickiness overlapping L=0). The harness uses `interior_locations` for detection; `x0` is carried as metadata.

A_He. Optimizer x0=0 (pipeline fact) coincides with L=0, but the empirical interior spike is at x=1 — NOT at x0. The 120,712 samples at exactly x=0 are lower-boundary stickiness (covered by lower=true). Interior spike at x=1 is ~3.2K excess over ~14.7K baseline per ab_a_interior_zoom.pdf 2026-04-18 — a ~22% bump, weaker than current detector tuning. Upper shelf at U=25 (32,459 samples at x=25).
